svg.aria-label: A list of GitHub Copilot's seven types and what each does in the example: instructions for Decimal money scoped by applyTo, a prompt file that checks one claimed saving, a skill with the steps and a script, a read-only custom agent, a subagent that is not a file you write, hooks that deny an overstated saving, and five MCP tools over stdio with three over HTTP

g.font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
g.text: Seven ways to build with Copilot. One example.
Each type's job in finding the subscriptions on a made-up statement.
Decimal for money. No advice. Three files scoped by applyTo
/review-summary: check one claimed saving by hand
find-subscriptions: the steps, the format and a script
statement-auditor: an allowlist with nothing that writes
Deny a saving above the latest charge. Refuse to stop unfinished
Five tools over stdio, and the three read tools over HTTP
Not a file you write, so there is nothing in the repository
